<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="hu">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Jade - Intelligens Kutatási Platform</title>
    <meta name="description" content="Jade - Fejlett AI kutatási platform több modell együttműködésével">
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#FF1493">
    <link rel="manifest" href="application/json;base64,eyJuYW1lIjoiSmFkZSIsInNob3J0X25hbWUiOiJKYWRlIiwic3RhcnRfdXJsIjoiLyIsImRpc3BsYXkiOiJzdGFuZGFsb25lIiwiYmFja2dyb3VuZF9jb2xvciI6IiNGRjE0OTMiLCJ0aGVtZV9jb2xvciI6IiNGRjE0OTMifQ==">
    <style>
        @import url('');
        
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --bg-primary: #FFF0F5;
            --bg-secondary: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
            --bg-tertiary: rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.9);
            --text-primary: #2D1B2E;
            --text-secondary: #8B4789;
            --text-tertiary: #C688C3;
            --accent-pink: #FF1493;
            --accent-gold: #FFD700;
            --accent-light-pink: #FF85C1;
            --accent-glow: rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.5);
            --border: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
            --shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.3);
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Poppins', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF0F5 0%, #FFE4F0 50%, #FFCFE5 100%);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
            -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
            position: relative;
        }

        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background-image: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 40% 20%, rgba(255, 133, 193, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }
        
        .hero {
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        
        #hero-background {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .hero-content {
            text-align: center;
            z-index: 1;
            max-width: 800px;
            padding: 0 20px;
            animation: fadeIn 1s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        .logo {
            font-size: 72px;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-pink) 0%, var(--accent-gold) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            text-shadow: 0 0 30px var(--accent-glow);
            filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3));
        }

        .tagline {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-pink);
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.2);
        }

        .subtitle {
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: 48px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            max-width: 550px;
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
        }

        .cta-button {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-pink) 0%, var(--accent-light-pink) 100%);
            color: white;
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-gold);
            padding: 14px 36px;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;
            border-radius: 980px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 25px var(--accent-glow), 0 0 20px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }
        
        .cta-button:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.08);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 35px var(--accent-glow), 0 0 40px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.5);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-light-pink) 0%, var(--accent-pink) 100%);
        }

        .app-container {
            display: none;
            min-height: 100vh;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .app-header {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
            padding: 12px 24px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.1);
        }

        .app-logo {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-pink) 0%, var(--accent-gold) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .mode-toggle {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.9) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 100%);
            padding: 4px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.15);
        }

        .mode-btn {
            padding: 8px 18px;
            border: none;
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            border-radius: 16px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .mode-btn.active {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-pink) 0%, var(--accent-light-pink) 100%);
            color: white;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .main-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 20px;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .chat-area,
        .sidebar {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
            border-radius: 16px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.15);
        }

        .chat-area {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .messages {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 20px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .message {
            max-width: 85%;
            animation: slideIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(15px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        .message.user {
            align-self: flex-end;
        }

        .message-content {
            padding: 14px 18px;
            border-radius: 18px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .message.user .message-content {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-pink) 0%, var(--accent-light-pink) 100%);
            color: white;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px var(--accent-glow);
            border: 1px solid var(--accent-gold);
        }

        .message.assistant .message-content {
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .message-meta {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-tertiary);
        }

        .input-area {
            padding: 14px;
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border);
            background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.5) 0%, transparent 100%);
        }

        .input-wrapper {
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            align-items: flex-end;
        }

        .message-input {
            flex: 1;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 0%, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.9) 100%);
            border: 2px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 12px 18px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 14px;
            resize: none;
            max-height: 90px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .message-input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--accent-pink);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .send-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-pink) 0%, var(--accent-light-pink) 100%);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-gold);
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .send-btn:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-light-pink) 0%, var(--accent-pink) 100%);
            transform: scale(1.15) rotate(5deg);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 25px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .send-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.5;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        .send-btn svg {
            transition: transform 0.2s ease-in-out;
        }

        .send-btn:hover svg {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .sidebar {
            width: 280px;
            padding: 20px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 18px;
        }

        .sidebar-section h3 {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-pink);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .stat-card {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 0%, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.9) 100%);
            padding: 14px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.1);
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-pink) 0%, var(--accent-gold) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .source-item {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) 0%, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.8) 100%);
            padding: 12px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: 2px solid transparent;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .source-item:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent-pink);
            transform: translateX(4px);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.9) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 100%);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .source-title {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .source-url {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-tertiary);
            text-decoration: none;
            display: block;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .loading {
            display: inline-flex;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 8px 0;
        }

        .loading span {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-pink) 0%, var(--accent-gold) 100%);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: bounce 1.4s infinite ease-in-out both;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .loading span:nth-child(1) {
            animation-delay: -0.32s;
        }

        .loading span:nth-child(2) {
            animation-delay: -0.16s;
        }

        @keyframes bounce {
            0%, 80%, 100% {
                transform: scale(0);
            }
            40% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
        }

        .research-widget-interactive {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) 0%, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.95) 100%);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-gold);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 16px;
            margin-top: 12px;
            animation: slideIn 0.3s ease-out;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.2);
        }

        .research-widget-interactive:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent-pink);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px var(--accent-glow);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .research-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .research-spinner {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            border: 3px solid var(--border);
            border-top-color: var(--accent-pink);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            to {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
        }

        .research-title {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .live-status-container {
            position: relative;
            height: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .live-status-item {
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            transition: opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease;
        }

        .live-status-item.current {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .live-status-item.previous {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(-100%);
        }

        .live-status-item.next {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(100%);
        }
        
        .research-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-pink) 0%, var(--accent-light-pink) 100%);
            color: white;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-left: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px var(--accent-glow);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .modal-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.2);
            backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
            z-index: 1000;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

        .modal-overlay.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            pointer-events: all;
        }

        .modal-content {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-gold);
            border-radius: 20px;
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 800px;
            max-height: 80vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 28px;
            transform: scale(0.95);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.3);
        }

        .modal-overlay.visible .modal-content {
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        .modal-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .modal-title {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-pink) 0%, var(--accent-gold) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .modal-close {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 28px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .modal-close:hover {
            color: var(--accent-pink);
            transform: rotate(90deg);
        }

        .analysis-section h4 {
            font-size: 14px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--accent-pink);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .analysis-section pre {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.5) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) 100%);
            padding: 14px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: pre-wrap;
            word-wrap: break-word;
            max-height: 250px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border);
        }

        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .sidebar {
                display: none;
            }
            .main-content {
                padding: 16px;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 640px) {
            .logo {
                font-size: 56px;
            }
            .tagline {
                font-size: 22px;
            }
            .subtitle {
                font-size: 15px;
            }
            .main-content {
                padding: 12px;
            }
            .chat-area,
            .sidebar {
                border-radius: 12px;
            }
        }

        .status-indicator {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-pink) 0%, var(--accent-gold) 100%);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: inline-block;
            margin-right: 8px;
            animation: pulse-dot 2s infinite;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        @keyframes pulse-dot {
            0%, 100% {
                opacity: 1;
                box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
            }
            50% {
                opacity: 0.6;
                box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-glow);
            }
        }

        .report-section {
            margin-top: 16px;
            padding: 22px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) 0%, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.95) 100%);
            border-radius: 16px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border);
        }

        .report-section h1,
        .report-section h2,
        .report-section h3 {
            margin-top: 1em;
            margin-bottom: 0.5em;
            color: var(--accent-pink);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .report-section h1 {
            font-size: 22px;
        }

        .report-section h2 {
            font-size: 19px;
        }

        .report-section h3 {
            font-size: 17px;
        }

        .report-section strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .report-section sup {
            color: var(--accent-pink);
            font-weight: 700;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="hero" id="hero">
        <canvas id="hero-background"></canvas>
        <div class="hero-content">
            <div class="logo">Jade</div>
            <div class="tagline">Intelligencia Határokon Túl</div>
            <div class="subtitle">
                Használd ki a kollaboratív AI erejét hogy több ezer forrásból kutass, elemezz és szintetizálj információkat. 
                Jade nem csak keres—gondolkodik, értékel és felfedez. Akár órákig kutathat autonomikusan és 20-30 oldalas jelentést készít.
            </div>
            <button class="cta-button" onclick="startApp()">Kutatás Indítása</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="app-container" id="app">
        <div class="app-header">
            <div class="app-logo">Jade</div>
            <div class="mode-toggle">
                <button class="mode-btn active" data-mode="chat">Chat</button>
                <button class="mode-btn" data-mode="research">Kutatás</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="main-content">
            <div class="chat-area">
                <div class="messages" id="messages"></div>
                <div class="input-area">
                    <div class="input-wrapper">
                        <textarea 
                            class="message-input" 
                            id="messageInput" 
                            placeholder="Kérdezz bármit vagy indíts mély kutatást..."
                            rows="1"
                        ></textarea>
                        <button class="send-btn" id="sendBtn" onclick="sendMessage()">
                             <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="5"></line><polyline points="5 12 12 5 19 12"></polyline></svg>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="sidebar">
                <div class="sidebar-section">
                    <h3>Státusz</h3>
                    <div class="stat-card">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="sourceCount">0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">Elemzett Forrás</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="sidebar-section">
                    <h3>Friss Források</h3>
                    <div id="sourcesList"></div>
                </div>

                <div class="sidebar-section">
                    <h3>Rendszer</h3>
                    <div class="stat-card">
                        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; font-size: 14px;">
                            <span class="status-indicator"></span>
                            <span>Minden Rendszer Működik</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div id="analysis-modal" class="modal-overlay">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <h3 class="modal-title">AI Gondolatmenet</h3>
                <button class="modal-close" onclick="hideAnalysisModal()">×</button>
            </div>
            <div class="analysis-section">
                <h4>Stratégia</h4>
                <pre id="analysis-strategy"></pre>
            </div>
            <div class="analysis-section">
                <h4>Elemzés</h4>
                <pre id="analysis-reasoning"></pre>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('hero-background');
        if(canvas) {
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            let width, height, particles = [];
            const particleConfig = {
                count: 120,
                speed: 0.08,
                radius: 1.5,
                colors: ['rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.8)', 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.8)', 'rgba(255, 133, 193, 0.8)', 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)']
            };

            const resize = () => {
                width = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
            };

            const createParticles = () => {
                particles = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < particleConfig.count; i++) {
                    particles.push({
                        x: Math.random() * width,
                        y: Math.random() * height,
                        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * particleConfig.speed,
                        vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * particleConfig.speed,
                        color: particleConfig.colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * particleConfig.colors.length)]
                    });
                }
            };

            const animate = () => {
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.x += p.vx;
                    p.y += p.vy;
                    if (p.x < 0 || p.x > width) p.vx *= -1;
                    if (p.y < 0 || p.y > height) p.vy *= -1;
                    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
                    ctx.shadowColor = p.color;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, particleConfig.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                });
                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            };

            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                resize();
                createParticles();
            });

            resize();
            createParticles();
            animate();
        }

        let currentMode = 'chat';
        let isProcessing = false;
        let currentAnalysis = null;

        function startApp() {
            document.getElementById('hero').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('app').style.display = 'flex';
            addMessage('assistant', 'Üdvözlöm a Jade-ben! Segíthetek gyors kérdésekben vagy mélyreható kutatást végezhetek több ezer forrásból. Akár órákig kutathatok és részletes jelentést készítek. Miben segíthetek?');
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                btn.classList.add('active');
                currentMode = btn.dataset.mode;
                document.getElementById('messageInput').placeholder = currentMode === 'research' 
                    ? 'Írja be a kutatási kérdést mélyreható elemzéshez...'
                    : 'Kérdezz bármit vagy indíts mély kutatást...';
            });
        });

        const messageInput = document.getElementById('messageInput');
        messageInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
            messageInput.style.height = 'auto';
            messageInput.style.height = `${Math.min(messageInput.scrollHeight, 90)}px`;
        });

        messageInput.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendMessage();
            }
        });

        function addMessage(role, content, meta = {}) {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
            messageDiv.className = `message ${role}`;
            const metaHtml = meta.type ? `<div class="message-meta"><span class="research-badge">${meta.type}</span></div>` : '';
            const formattedContent = meta.type === 'AUTONÓM KUTATÁS' ? formatReport(content) : formatContent(content);
            messageDiv.innerHTML = `${metaHtml}<div class="message-content ${meta.type === 'AUTONÓM KUTATÁS' ? 'report-section' : ''}">${formattedContent}</div>`;
            messagesDiv.appendChild(messageDiv);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
        }

        function formatContent(text) {
            return text.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>').replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>').replace(/$$(\d+)$$/g, '<sup>[$1]</sup>').replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
        }

        function formatReport(text) {
            return text.replace(/^# (.*?)$/gm, '<h1>$1</h1>').replace(/^## (.*?)$/gm, '<h2>$1</h2>').replace(/^### (.*?)$/gm, '<h3>$1</h3>').replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>').replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>').replace(/$$(\d+)$$/g, '<sup>[$1]</sup>').replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
        }
        
        function showLoading() {
            if (document.getElementById('loading')) return;
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const loadingDiv = document.createElement('div');
            loadingDiv.className = 'message assistant';
            loadingDiv.id = 'loading';
            loadingDiv.innerHTML = `<div class="message-content"><div class="loading"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div></div>`;
            messagesDiv.appendChild(loadingDiv);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
        }

        function removeLoading() {
            const loading = document.getElementById('loading');
            if(loading) loading.remove();
        }

        function showResearchWidget(analysis) {
            currentAnalysis = analysis;
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const widgetWrapper = document.createElement('div');
            widgetWrapper.className = 'message assistant';
            widgetWrapper.id = 'research-widget-wrapper';
            
            widgetWrapper.innerHTML = `
                <div class="research-widget-interactive" onclick="showAnalysisModal()">
                    <div class="research-header">
                        <div class="research-spinner"></div>
                        <div class="research-title">Kutatás folyamatban...</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="live-status-container" id="live-status-container">
                        <span class="live-status-item current">Stratégia kidolgozása...</span>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
            messagesDiv.appendChild(widgetWrapper);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
        }
        
        function updateLiveResearchStatus(text) {
            const container = document.getElementById('live-status-container');
            if (!container) return;

            const oldStatus = container.querySelector('.current');
            if(oldStatus) {
                oldStatus.classList.remove('current');
                oldStatus.classList.add('previous');
                setTimeout(() => oldStatus.remove(), 500);
            }
            
            const newStatus = document.createElement('span');
            newStatus.className = 'live-status-item next';
            newStatus.textContent = text;
            container.appendChild(newStatus);

            setTimeout(() => {
                newStatus.classList.remove('next');
                newStatus.classList.add('current');
            }, 10);
        }

        function showAnalysisModal() {
            if (!currentAnalysis) return;
            document.getElementById('analysis-strategy').textContent = currentAnalysis.strategy;
            document.getElementById('analysis-reasoning').textContent = currentAnalysis.reasoning;
            document.getElementById('analysis-modal').classList.add('visible');
        }

        function hideAnalysisModal() {
            document.getElementById('analysis-modal').classList.remove('visible');
        }

        function removeResearchWidget() {
            const widget = document.getElementById('research-widget-wrapper');
            if(widget) widget.remove();
        }

        function updateSources(sources, count) {
            document.getElementById('sourceCount').textContent = count || 0;
            const sourcesList = document.getElementById('sourcesList');
            sourcesList.innerHTML = '';
            if (sources) {
                sources.slice(0, 5).forEach(source => {
                    const sourceDiv = document.createElement('div');
                    sourceDiv.className = 'source-item';
                    let hostname = 'N/A';
                    try {
                        hostname = new URL(source.url).hostname;
                    } catch (_) {}
                    sourceDiv.innerHTML = `<div class="source-title">${source.title || 'Cím nélküli'}</div>
                        ${hostname}`;
                    sourcesList.appendChild(sourceDiv);
                });
            }
        }
        
        async function handleResearch(query) {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/research', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ query })
                });
                if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
                const data = await response.json();
                if (data.error) throw new Error(data.error);
                
                showResearchWidget(data.analysis);

                if(data.research_log) {
                    for (const log of data.research_log) {
                        const detail = log.includes(':') ? log.split(': ').slice(1).join(': ') : log;
                        updateLiveResearchStatus(detail);
                        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); 
                    }
                }
                
                updateLiveResearchStatus('Szintézis és jelentés generálás...');

                setTimeout(() => {
                    removeResearchWidget();
                    addMessage('assistant', data.answer, { type: 'AUTONÓM KUTATÁS' });
                    updateSources(data.sources, data.sources_count);
                }, 1500);

            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Research error:', error);
                removeResearchWidget();
                addMessage('assistant', `Hiba történt a kutatás során: ${error.message}`);
            }
        }

        async function handleChat(query) {
            showLoading();
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ query })
                });
                
                removeLoading();
                if (!response.body) throw new Error("No response body");
                
                const reader = response.body.getReader();
                const decoder = new TextDecoder();
                let fullResponse = '';
                const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
                messageDiv.className = 'message assistant';
                messageDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="message-content"></div>';
                document.getElementById('messages').appendChild(messageDiv);
                const contentDiv = messageDiv.querySelector('.message-content');

                while (true) {
                    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
                    if (done) break;
                    const chunk = decoder.decode(value, {stream: true});
                    
                    const lines = chunk.split('\n\n');
                    for (const line of lines) {
                        if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
                            const dataString = line.substring(6).trim();
                            if (dataString === '[DONE]') break;
                            if(dataString) {
                                try {
                                    const parsed = JSON.parse(dataString);
                                    if (parsed.content) {
                                        fullResponse += parsed.content;
                                        contentDiv.innerHTML = formatContent(fullResponse);
                                        messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
                                    } else if (parsed.error) {
                                        throw new Error(parsed.error);
                                    }
                                } catch (e) {}
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Chat error:', error);
                removeLoading();
                addMessage('assistant', `Hiba történt a csevegés során: ${error.message}`);
            }
        }

        async function sendMessage() {
            const input = document.getElementById('messageInput');
            const message = input.value.trim();
            if (!message || isProcessing) return;
            
            addMessage('user', message);
            input.value = '';
            input.style.height = 'auto';
            isProcessing = true;
            document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = true;
            
            if (currentMode === 'research') {
                await handleResearch(message);
            } else {
                await handleChat(message);
            }
            
            isProcessing = false;
            document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = false;
        }

        if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
            navigator.serviceWorker.register('data:text/javascript,');
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
